# Rune patches

No local patches. The four previously carried behaviors — inline objects with
fractional metrics/rise/labels, a11y label substitution, inline-image highlight
boxes, and static Mermaid SVG — landed upstream in Rune `07bf8c5d3` (#2743).
`07bf8c5d3` onward also supplies the kit shell hooks and core input/clipboard
APIs. `vendor/rune/patches/` is intentionally empty.
